name: Milwaukee River
blurb: Milwaukee River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. This is a long section and may require more than one day; plan daylight, supplies and legal overnight stops. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Barton, West Bend. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float. A dam lies near a section endpoint (Kewaskum). The landing’s position relative to the barrier still needs confirmation.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Barton, West Bend, Kewaskum and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

notices.title: Bridge Street Dam portage
notices.text: Use the signed upstream take-out near Veterans Memorial Park and the street portage around Bridge Street Dam. The water-trail guide describes a 1,200-foot carry; check current signs and access.
notices.sourceName: Milwaukee Riverkeeper — county-endorsed Urban Water Trail, 2018

notices.title: Take out before Thiensville Dam
notices.text: This trip ends at the upstream boat ramp in Village Park. Take out before the dam; do not continue through the dam or fishway.
